title: Cannot get data of `TEXTURE_USAGE_CPU_READ_BIT` texture on Vulkan
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1, 4.5.beta6
- Not reproducible in 4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta6 - EndeavourOS  SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 20 Aug 2025 21:43:45 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 14.98 GiB memory

### Issue description

~This seems the same with #108115 but on Vulkan.~(No, this is about reading `TEXTURE_USAGE_CPU_READ_BIT` texture). I tested the MRP in #93687 and encountered:
```
~> Godot_v4.5-beta6_linux.x86_64 --gpu-validation --path .

...
SSBO: Took 260 us to read 4 bytes, 0.0146719125601 MB/s
ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 1849378557920914
vkMapMemory(): Mapping memory without VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT set. Memory has type 0 which has properties VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT.
The Vulkan spec states: memory must have been created with a memory type that reports VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/memory.html#VUID-vkMapMemory-memory-00682)
   at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:98)
       [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:110)
WARNING: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 237331824
VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED
     at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:662)
     GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
         [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:98)
         [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:110)
ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 1849378557920914
vkMapMemory(): Mapping memory without VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT set. Memory has type 0 which has properties VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT.
The Vulkan spec states: memory must have been created with a memory type that reports VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/memory.html#VUID-vkMapMemory-memory-00682)
   at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:98)
       [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:110)
WARNING: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 237331824
VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED
     at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:662)
     GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
         [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:98)
         [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:110)
ERROR: vkMapMemory failed with error -5.
   at: texture_map (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:2260)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:98)
       [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:110)
ERROR: Parameter "img_mem" is null.
   at: _texture_get_data (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:1934)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] textureTest (res://test_overhead.gd:98)
       [1] _ready (res://test_overhead.gd:110)
Texture: Took 1222 us to read 0 bytes, 0.0 MB/s
```

If I remove `TEXTURE_USAGE_CPU_READ_BIT`, then no errors:
```
SSBO: Took 180 us to read 4 bytes, 0.02119276258681 MB/s
Texture: Took 1841 us to read 4 bytes, 0.00207207890583 MB/s
```
Interestingly, the read speed of SSBO is always much faster than that of texture, regardless of whether I reverse the reading order ( which is different from Godot 4.3).
```
Texture: Took 1936 us to read 4 bytes, 0.00197040148018 MB/s
SSBO: Took 195 us to read 4 bytes, 0.01956255008013 MB/s
```

### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP in #93687


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The MRP in #93687
